meta.title: Recognise a material PR line from its details

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where sourceable PRs are available.

args.goal: Find an open material PR line, open its PR number, open the line's Details view, and verify that Item Type is M/Material, a material code is shown, Account Assignment Category is empty or K, and the quantity and unit are displayed; stop on the line Details view.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for opening a PR number and its line Details, so this performs and observes the required buyer-side inspection.
Confirm the line Details view exposes the item type field.
Confirm the material/service code field is visible.
Confirm the account assignment field is visible for checking empty stock or K cost-centre assignment.
Ensure the inspected details screen has no rendering or server errors.
